description: This file defines classes and templates related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator classes for null, carriage return, and line feed, as well as a template class for stream text handling with customizable terminators. It appears to be part of a core library for handling text streams with specific termination sequences.

classes.description: Template class for handling text streams with customizable terminators, supporting data sending and receiving, with internal handler types.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the stream, handling internal queue and terminator markers.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detecting terminator sequences and reporting received text.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits text to be sent over the stream.

methods.description: Checks if the stream is open.

methods.description: Checks if the stream is closed.
